name: Example devcontainer for add-on repositories
postStartCommand: bash -c 'mkdir -p /run/supervisor; apply_supervisor_patch() { local ws="${WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY:-$(pwd)}"; local patch="$ws/supervisor_firewall_patch.py"; echo "Waiting for hassio_supervisor container..."; for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker ps 2>/dev/null | grep -q hassio_supervisor && break; sleep 2; done; if docker ps 2>/dev/null | grep -q hassio_supervisor; then echo "Applying supervisor devcontainer patches..."; docker cp "$patch" hassio_supervisor:/usr/src/supervisor/supervisor/host/firewall.py && docker exec hassio_supervisor find /usr/src/supervisor/supervisor/host/__pycache__ -name "firewall*.pyc" -delete 2>/dev/null; docker cp "$ws/supervisor_api_patch.py" hassio_supervisor:/usr/src/supervisor/supervisor/homeassistant/api.py && docker exec hassio_supervisor find /usr/src/supervisor/supervisor/homeassistant/__pycache__ -name "api*.pyc" -delete 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p /run/os && ln -sf /run/supervisor/core.sock /run/os/core.sock 2>/dev/null; docker restart hassio_supervisor && echo "Supervisor patches applied successfully"; else echo "Warning: hassio_supervisor not found, skipping patches"; fi; }; if docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1 && docker ps | grep -q hassio_supervisor; then echo "Home Assistant supervisor is already running"; nohup bash -c "sleep 3 && apply_supervisor_patch" > /tmp/patch.log 2>&1 &; elif docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Docker is running but supervisor not found. Starting..."; nohup supervisor_run > /tmp/supervisor.log 2>&1 & nohup bash -c "sleep 10 && apply_supervisor_patch" > /tmp/patch.log 2>&1 &; else echo "Starting Home Assistant (Docker may take up to 30 seconds to start)..."; nohup supervisor_run > /tmp/supervisor.log 2>&1 & nohup bash -c "sleep 25 && apply_supervisor_patch" > /tmp/patch.log 2>&1 &; for i in {1..6}; do if docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Docker started successfully"; break; else echo "Waiting for Docker to start... ($i/6)"; sleep 5; fi; done; if docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Home Assistant supervisor starting..."; else echo "Warning: Docker may not have started yet. Check /tmp/supervisor.log"; fi; fi'
